name: rillo
trademark_risk: No famous "RILLO" mark found, and no confirmed live USPTO registration for RILLO itself in classes 9/41/42 surfaced via search. Related hits: "RILLO RYE" (beer, class 32, live) and Rillo LLC as owner of the unrelated mark MINDEZY. However, rillo.ai (AI practice-management SaaS for health clinics) is an operating software company that likely holds or will claim rights in the software/AI space, and Rilla (rilla.com / Rilla Voice, a well-funded NYC AI company with ~$79M raised) is phonetically near-identical and operates AI mobile apps — a serious likelihood-of-confusion vector in classes 9/42. EUIPO/UKIPO/WIPO could not be queried directly; treat as unverified, but the common-law landscape alone is crowded.
appstore_play_risk: No popular consumer app named exactly "Rillo" found. Minor conflicts: "Rillo - Drinking Game" (Android party game) and "Rillo de Gallo Arcade Game" (Amazon Appstore). The bigger problem is "Rilla: The AI Sales Coach" — live on both the App Store and Google Play, one letter and phonetically almost identical, in the AI-app category. An education/AI app named Rillo would sit next to Rilla in search results and could draw an app-store name dispute.
linguistic_issues: Significant: in US English slang, "rillo" = cigarillo, specifically one hollowed out to roll a blunt (marijuana) — the top Urban Dictionary sense. For a wellness/education app with Duolingo/Finch-style (often young) audiences, this drug-adjacent slang is an unfortunate association, though not offensive per se. Otherwise benign: Italian surname element meaning "small ridge/hillock"; Spanish diminutive of "rio" (little river) and a real village (Rillo, Teruel, Spain); no negative meanings found in French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Russian, or Indonesian. Pronunciation is easy but ambiguous: English speakers say RIL-oh, Spanish speakers read double-L as "y" (REE-yo). Near-homophones/confusables: Rilla, Rylo, Rillet, Brillo (famous cleaning-pad brand, unrelated class).
social_handles: Heavily occupied. "Rillo" is an established tech/content creator (rillotv): ~362k TikTok, ~107k YouTube, ~116k Instagram as of end-2023; handles @rillotv (X/YouTube), @rillotok (TikTok) are his, and youtube.com/rillo resolves to him. "rillo" is also taken as a PyPI package (event-sourcing framework) and a crates.io Rust crate. Clean @rillo handles are almost certainly unavailable on major platforms.
web_usage: Crowded. Active same-name software companies: rillo.ai (AI-native practice management for allied-health clinics, HIPAA/PIPEDA, Canadian) — notably adjacent to the "wellness + AI" positioning; rillo.io (a SaaS with login/register pages); rilloo.com (software dev shop); Rillo LLC (Washington DC); Rillo S.A.C (Peru). Rillo is also a moderately common Italian/Filipino/Spanish surname (e.g. athletes, musicians, a Spotify artist) and a Spanish place name. rillo.com does not appear to host a distinct major brand but the name has no clear white space.
summary: "Rillo" is not clear. No famous mark or popular identical consumer app blocks it outright, but three conflicts stack up: (1) rillo.ai is a live AI software company in the health/wellness-adjacent space with the exact name; (2) Rilla, a ~$79M-funded AI company, ships near-identically named apps on both stores, creating real trademark-confusion and app-store-search risk for an AI app; (3) "rillo" is established US slang for a blunt/cigarillo — a poor fit for an education+wellness brand aimed at broad audiences. Social handles (@rillo/@rillotv) are held by a 350k+-follower creator, and rillo.io/rilloo.com/PyPI/crates are taken. Graded HIGH_RISK: an established same-space (AI software) company exists at the exact name, compounded by the Rilla collision and slang issue. Recommend passing on this candidate unless legal clearance against rillo.ai and Rilla comes back clean and the team accepts the slang connotation.

name: bolio
trademark_risk: No live US mark found in software/app classes (Nice 9, 41, 42). Live/registered US marks on the identical word exist in unrelated classes: BOLIO (Reg. 6650774, Bolio Designs Inc, Boulder CO) for coffee filters (classes 11/16/21, registered Feb 2022), and a BOLIO application by Bolio Forklifts Inc (Ser. 97807684) for forklift distributorship/retail services (class 35). An earlier BOLIO food-products filing (Ser. 85320722, Imtrex Inc) is dead/abandoned. Adjacent famous-ish mark: EMACK & BOLIO'S, the well-known Boston ice cream chain — a composite mark in food/restaurant space, unlikely to block an education/AI app but a name-recognition overlap in the US Northeast. No EUIPO/UKIPO/WIPO software marks surfaced via search, but official EUIPO eSearch/WIPO Global Brand Database were not directly queryable from search results and should be verified before filing.
appstore_play_risk: No app named exactly "Bolio" found on Google Play or the Apple App Store. However, the near-name space is crowded with confusingly similar education/productivity apps: Google's "Bolo" (now Read Along) reading-tutor app for children — directly in the education space; "Blio" (content-saving app, App Store); "Boloo" (AI assistant for bol.com sellers); "Bolo" AI project management; "BOLI by Yashee" language learning. A one-letter-different Google-owned education app ("Bolo") is the most notable confusion vector for an education app, though Google has since rebranded it to Read Along.
linguistic_issues: Main issue: in Mexican/Chicano slang, "bolio" is a phonetic variant of "bolillo" — literally a white bread roll, used as slang for a white person, or pejoratively for a Latino seen as "brown outside, white inside" (a coconut-type insult; documented on Urban Dictionary and slang sites). Mild, not obscene, but a real liability for a US consumer app with Spanish-speaking users. Otherwise no negative meanings found in French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Russian, or Indonesian; Wiktionary lists it only as a rare alternative form of "boliah." Pronunciation is easy (BO-lee-oh) but ambiguity with Bolo/Boliyo/Bolillo/Folio creates spelling/homophone confusion; "bolio" also invites the misreading "bolo" or "polio"-adjacent visual similarity some reviewers may flag.
social_handles: The clean handle is largely taken in software-adjacent contexts: GitHub org "bolio-ui" runs Bolio UI, an active open-source React component library (plus bolio-ui.com domain) — a direct software-space name occupant; github.com/SiBolio/bolio is a Flutter/ioBroker app. Instagram @bolio.se is a small Swedish cleaning service; @b0lio and personal accounts (Carlos Bolio etc.) occupy variants. No large influencer/brand owns "bolio" on X/TikTok/YouTube per search, but expect to compromise on handles (e.g. getbolio, bolioapp).
web_usage: Moderately crowded. Bolio is a genuine Hispanic surname (common in Yucatán, Mexico — many individuals: patents by Hugo Bolio Arceo, several US court cases Bolio v. ...). It is also the name of a famous American Pit Bull Terrier fighting/breeding bloodline ("Indian Bolio," 1969) with heavy usage in dog-breeding communities — an unfortunate association (dog fighting) that dominates some search results. Plus Emack & Bolio's ice cream, Bolio Forklifts, Bolio Designs coffee gear, Bolio UI library, and near-names Balio (SaaS holding co) and bol.com. The name is not ownable as a unique token; SEO will compete with the surname, the pit bull bloodline, and the ice cream chain.
summary: "Bolio" is legally viable but not clean. No live software/app trademark (classes 9/41/42) or existing app with the exact name was found, so there is no fatal blocker. The risks are reputational and practical: (1) live identical-word US marks in other classes (coffee filters, forklifts) plus the well-known Emack & Bolio's ice cream brand; (2) Mexican slang meaning ("bolillo" variant — a mild ethnic pejorative for a white or "whitewashed" person), a real concern for a US consumer app; (3) the name is a common Yucatecan surname and, awkwardly, a famous dog-fighting pit bull bloodline that dominates parts of search; (4) the software-space name is partly occupied by the open-source Bolio UI React library and clean social handles are taken. Grade: MODERATE_RISK — usable with eyes open, but expect handle compromises, SEO competition, and a Spanish-market perception check; verify EUIPO/WIPO directly before filing.

name: kirone
trademark_risk: No live "KIRONE" mark surfaced in USPTO/EUIPO/WIPO results via search (searches returned only near-misses like KRONE/KRONER); a direct TESS/TMview query could not be completed from this environment, so treat as unverified-but-likely-clear for an exact match. The real trademark exposure is confusing similarity to adjacent marks: KIRON (Kiron Open Higher Education, Germany — education platform), KIRO (AWS AI coding product), KIRONA (UK workforce software). "Kirone" is the Italian spelling-variant of Chirone/Chiron, so Chiron-derived marks in ed/health also crowd the field. A phonetic-similarity objection from Kiron (education, Nice 41/42) is the most plausible conflict for an education+AI app.
appstore_play_risk: No app named "Kirone" found on Google Play or the App Store. However "Kiron Campus" (Kiron Open Higher Education) is a live education/learning app on Google Play — one letter away and in the same category (education), which creates real store-search and user-confusion risk. Other near names (Kiro, Kiron Digital) also exist as developers. Exact-name availability appears open.
linguistic_issues: No offensive or negative meanings found in the checked languages. Italian: Kirone/Chirone = Chiron, the wise centaur who tutored heroes and was a healer — actually an apt, positive allusion for an education+wellness brand, though it means the name is not truly "invented" in Italy. English: rare given name (variant of Kieran/Tyrone, glossed "anointed"). No known meaning in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin pinyin, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Russian, or Indonesian. Main issue is pronunciation ambiguity: ki-ROH-neh (Italian) vs. KY-rone vs. ki-ROHN; also easily misheard/misspelled as Kiron, Kirin (famous Japanese beverage brand, phonetically nearby), or Krone.
social_handles: Not heavily colonized, but the clean namespace is partly taken: Instagram @kirone69 (Belgian artist) and @kironeistituto (Italian training institute, also on Facebook); a small YouTube channel @kirone-1 exists. No prominent X/TikTok/GitHub brand named exactly "kirone" surfaced. Exact handle @kirone availability uncertain but no major squatter found.
web_usage: Lightly crowded, concentrated in Italy: kirone.org (first-aid training company, active since 2017), progettokirone.it (holistic wellness/naturopathy institute — overlaps the wellness positioning), Kirone Istituto di Ricerca e Formazione (research/training institute), studiomedicokirone.com (medical practice), plus a personal-growth group in Cosenza. kirone.com is parked for sale on HugeDomains (~$1,295), so the .com is buyable. Rare surname/first name; not a place name. Globally the name is low-noise outside Italy.
summary: "Kirone" has no exact live software trademark, no existing app-store app, and no negative meaning in major languages — and the buyable .com is a plus. The two real risks: (1) Kiron Open Higher Education, an established education nonprofit with a live Google Play learning app, is phonetically near-identical and in the same space (education), creating trademark-confusion and app-store-search risk; (2) in Italy the name is a known word (Chiron) already used by several small wellness/training/education businesses, which weakens distinctiveness there and could spawn local oppositions. Net: MODERATE_RISK — usable, but commission a professional clearance search focused on KIRON/CHIRON-family marks in Nice classes 9/41/42 (US, EU, UK) before committing, and expect pronunciation/spelling drift toward "Kiron."

name: riona

It is a genuine Irish girls' name (Ríona/Ríoghnach, "queenly") — positive connotation — and a common Japanese female given name (リオナ, various kanji). Pronunciation is easy (ree-OH-nah) but spelling/pronunciation ambiguity exists: readers may say RYE-oh-na, and it is one letter from Fiona and phonetically adjacent to Rihanna, causing "did you mean…" confusion. In Italian it evokes "rione" (city district); no slang issue found in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Korean, Mandarin pinyin, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Russian, or Indonesian. social_handles: Bare handles appear taken or squatted; active users include @riona_fiemie (TikTok), @riona_dancer (Instagram), @therealriona, and notably Isaki Riona (礒生リオナ), a hololive DEV_IS VTuber with a large young audience whose fans dominate "Riona" social search results. summary: "Riona" has no fatal conflict — no famous trademark, no popular identical consumer app, and no offensive meaning; it is a pleasant, pronounceable Irish/Japanese girls' name. But the name is meaningfully crowded in exactly your space: an already-viral open-source "Riona AI Agent" project (plus a Solana memecoin riding it), a Capterra-listed generative-AI product named Riona, and riona.ai already operating as an AI/API company. Add a hololive VTuber (Isaki Riona) owning much of the social/search footprint, taken handles, and homophone confusion with Fiona/Rihanna/Riana. For a Finch/Duolingo-ambition consumer AI app, expect SEO/ASO noise, handle scarcity, and possible trademark friction as those AI uses mature. Grade: MODERATE_RISK — usable only after a direct USPTO/TMview clearance search comes back clean, and better alternatives likely exist.

Combined with tioni.com being held by a reseller and English pronunciation ambiguity from the "-tion" cluster, the name grades MODERATE_RISK: usable, but do a formal USPTO/TMview clearance (classes 9/41/42), budget for the .com, and assess coexistence or scope distance from Tioni GmbH before committing in Europe.

name: veki

"Veki" is also a Balkan personal nickname, generating diffuse personal-account usage. No single owner dominates the name.
summary: "Veki" is not fatally blocked but is not clean. No famous mark, no popular identical app, and no offensive meanings (Esperanto "to wake" is actually a fitting positive meaning for an education/wellness app). However, three real conflicts exist: an identical-name live chat/video app already on Google Play (Ignite Catalyst), a live US trademark "VEKI" in Class 18 (leather goods — different class, low but nonzero risk for merch), and Vekia, a funded French AI SaaS one letter away that could raise EU trademark and search-confusion issues for an AI-branded product. Handle @veki is likely unavailable and the name is a common Balkan nickname, diluting searchability. Grade: MODERATE_RISK — usable if you can (a) confirm classes 9/41/42 are clear via a professional EUIPO/USPTO search, (b) accept the Play Store name collision or persuade/outwait the existing app, and (c) secure veki.com or a strong alternative domain.

name: kelu
trademark_risk: Low-moderate. The only US "KELU" mark surfaced is SN 97887696 (Apples & Oranges USA, LLC, filed 2023, advertising/retail services) and it is DEAD/ABANDONED (no statement of use, Nov 2024). No live US/EU/WIPO software marks in classes 9/41/42 surfaced via search, and no famous "KELU" mark exists. Caveat: "Kelu" is the pinyin of Klook's Chinese name 客路 (Kèlù) — Klook's Chinese entity is "Shenzhen Kelu Network Technology Co., Ltd." — and of Shenzhen Clou/科陆 Electronics; conflict risk is in China, not Western registers, and their consumer brand is "Klook"/"Clou", not Kelu. A direct EUIPO/UKIPO/WIPO database query could not be run from search results, so treat EU/UK clearance as unverified.
appstore_play_risk: Moderate and squarely in-space: "Kelu: Speak Locally" is an existing Kannada language-learning app (Google Play, launched ~2014, named after Kannada kēḷu = "listen") — identical name, same education/language category as the proposed app, though it appears small and likely dormant (it no longer surfaces in current Play search; iOS version apparently never shipped). No popular app named exactly "Kelu" exists on either store today; near-names (Kaluu, Kulu, KELUDE, Kelkun) are minor. A dormant same-name, same-category app is a soft conflict that could still cause App Store name collision or a nuisance dispute.
linguistic_issues: Mixed. Positive: Kannada/Tamil/Tulu kēḷu (Proto-Dravidian *kēḷ-) means "listen / hear / ask" — actually flattering for an education app, but it is exactly why the existing Kannada app chose the name. Negative: in Malay/Indonesian, "kelu" is a real dictionary word meaning "tongue-tied / speechless, unable to speak (from fear or emotion)" — an unfortunate irony for a learning/communication app across ~300M speakers (e.g. book title "Perempuan-Perempuan Kelu" = The Silence of the Girls). Mandarin: kèlù 客路 = "traveler's road" (Klook's name); neutral. No meaning found in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, or Russian; nothing offensive anywhere. Pronunciation is easy (KEH-loo/KAY-loo) with minor ambiguity between the two; homophone risk with Kulu/Kaluu/Kelly-adjacent names is mild.
social_handles: No dominant "kelu" brand on X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or GitHub. Exact GitHub handle appears taken/near-taken (active users kelu124, keluo, kelue); Instagram shows only small personal/variant accounts (@kelu_ki_diwani_007 etc.). Expect the bare @kelu handle to be squatted by small personal accounts on major platforms — obtainable variants (getkelu, kelu_app, keluhq) would be needed. No cybersquatting by a competing brand detected.
web_usage: Lightly crowded with small, unrelated uses: Kelu cocktail bar in Sheffield UK (kelu.co.uk, plus kelu.co), The Kelu Project (Irish comms/PR consultancy, thekeluproject.ie), KELU Measuring Instrument Institute (China, via ZoomInfo). "Kelu" is also a given name (e.g. Kelu Chao, former acting USAGM CEO; listed on names.org) and appears as a Chinese pinyin surname/company element. kelu.com does not host an active brand (likely parked/held). Overall the name is uncrowded in the software space but not virgin territory.
summary: "Kelu" is registrable but not clean. No live trademark or famous mark blocks it (the one US KELU application is dead), and no popular app or funded startup owns the name. The two real issues: (1) an existing, apparently dormant Kannada language-learning app called "Kelu: Speak Locally" sits in exactly the proposed education space — same name, same category, chosen for the same Dravidian meaning "listen/ask"; (2) in Malay/Indonesian "kelu" literally means "tongue-tied/speechless," a bad look for a learning app in Southeast Asian markets. Add pinyin overlap with Klook (客路 Kèlù) in China, squatted-but-small social handles, and unavailable kelu.com/.co.uk, and the honest grade is MODERATE_RISK: usable for a US/EU launch with a filed trademark and variant handles, but do a formal EUIPO/UKIPO/TESS clearance search and reconsider if Indonesia/Malaysia or China are priority markets.

No famous mark found, but likelihood-of-confusion exposure in both consumer services and education is real. Direct TESS/EUIPO database queries could not be run (403); a professional clearance search is mandatory before filing in classes 9/41/42.

No popular app named exactly "Neli", but developer "NELI CREATIVE" (Da Nang, Vietnam) publishes on BOTH Apple App Store and Google Play, including "NeliZ: Motivation, Happiness" (wellness/motivation — your space) and "NelieX: Experience sharing" (learning-journey logging — your space).
